text:
If you’re heading out early, the frost advisory has just ended and the chilly start is real, 41 degrees under a clear sky. It’s a beautiful, crisp Thursday from here, with sunshine taking us to a high near 67 and only a light north breeze. The lake should stay especially manageable, with waves a foot or less today, though the water is just 63 degrees, so swimming remains a quick dip rather than a linger. Clear skies return tonight with a low around 48.

Friday keeps the same dry, sunny pattern and may feel a touch warmer, near 70, although a north wind could run stronger over the lake with waves up to 2 feet. The forecasters’ own discussion is increasingly confident that rain will make an appearance this weekend, likely arriving later Saturday and becoming more likely Sunday. Enjoy the outdoor window today and Friday, and keep longer waterfront plans south of Saturday afternoon.
